name: Douglas McGregor
excerpt: Douglas McGregor developed Theory X and Theory Y about work motivation.
notes: Douglas McGregor was a management theorist who developed Theory X and Theory Y, which describe two contrasting models of workforce motivation. Theory X assumes people avoid work, while Theory Y assumes people naturally want to work.
context_summary:
- Developed Theory X and Theory Y.
- Theory X assumes people avoid work.
- Theory Y assumes people want to work.
